headline: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - In continuation of the disclosure submitted by the Company on October 27, 2026, regarding the acquisition of shares of Hobel Bellows Private Limited, and pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the…
detail: General Updates - In continuation of the disclosure submitted by the Company on October 27, 2026, regarding the acquisition of shares of Hobel Bellows Private Limited, and pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations ), we hereby submit the additional details of the acquisition as required under the applicable SEBI Master Circular.
